# Random Canvas Game Idea

**Title:** Falling Blocks Dodge

- The player controls a small square that moves left/right at the bottom of the canvas.
- Colored blocks fall from the top with varying speeds.
- The player must dodge the blocks; touching a block ends the game.
- A simple score increments for each second survived.
- Lose condition: collision between the player square and any falling block.

The game can be built with pure HTML5 canvas, using basic shapes and keyboard input.

1: // Falling Blocks Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is assumed to exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11: 
12:   // Audio context and beep helper
13:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
14:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
15:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
16:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
17:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
18:     osc.type = 'sine';
19:     osc.connect(gain);
20:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
21:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
23:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
24:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
25:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
26:   }
27: 
28: 
29:   // Set canvas size (you can adjust as needed)
30:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
31:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
32: 
33:   const PLAYER_WIDTH = 40;
34:   const PLAYER_HEIGHT = 40;
35:   const PLAYER_SPEED = 5;
36:   const BLOCK_SIZE = 30;
37:   const BLOCK_MIN_SPEED = 2;
38:   const BLOCK_MAX_SPEED = 5;
39:   const BLOCK_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1000; // ms
40: 
41:   let player = {
42:     x: canvas.width / 2 - PLAYER_WIDTH / 2,
43:     y: canvas.height - PLAYER_HEIGHT - 10,
44:     width: PLAYER_WIDTH,
45:     height: PLAYER_HEIGHT,
46:     dx: 0,
47:   };
48: 
49:   let blocks = [];
50:   let lastSpawn = 0;
51:   let lastScoreTime = 0;
52:   let score = 0;
53:   let gameOver = false;
54: 
55:   // Helper: draw rounded rectangle
56:   function drawRoundedRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
57:     ctx.beginPath();
58:     ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
59:     ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
60:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
61:     ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
62:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
63:     ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
64:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
65:     ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
66:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
67:     ctx.closePath();
68:     ctx.fill();
69:   }
70: 
71:   // Input handling
72:   const keys = {};
73:   // Ensure audio context is resumed on first user interaction
74:   const resumeAudio = () => {
75:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
76:     window.removeEventListener('click', resumeAudio);
77:     window.removeEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio);
78:   };
79:   window.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio);
80:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio);
81: 
82:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
83:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = true;
84:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = true;
85:   });
86:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
87:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = false;
88:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = false;
89:   });
90: 
91:   function spawnBlock() {
92:     // Play a short puff sound when a block appears
93:     playBeep(200, 0.05);
94:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - BLOCK_SIZE);
95:     const speed = BLOCK_MIN_SPEED + Math.random() * (BLOCK_MAX_SPEED - BLOCK_MIN_SPEED);
96:     const hue = Math.floor(Math.random() * 360);
97:     const color = `hsl(${hue}, 70%, 50%)`;
98:     blocks.push({ x, y: -BLOCK_SIZE, size: BLOCK_SIZE, speed, color });
99:   }
100: 
101:   function update(delta) {
102:     // Update player position
103:     if (keys.left) player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED;
104:     if (keys.right) player.x += PLAYER_SPEED;
105:     // Keep player within bounds
106:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - PLAYER_WIDTH, player.x));
107: 
108:     // Update blocks
109:     for (let i = blocks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
110:       const b = blocks[i];
111:       b.y += b.speed;
112:       // Remove off-screen blocks
113:       if (b.y > canvas.height) blocks.splice(i, 1);
114:     }
115: 
116:     // Collision detection
117:     for (const b of blocks) {
118:       if (
119:         player.x < b.x + b.size &&
120:         player.x + PLAYER_WIDTH > b.x &&
121:         player.y < b.y + b.size &&
122:         player.y + PLAYER_HEIGHT > b.y
123:       ) {
124:         gameOver = true;
125:         playBeep(100, 0.3); // collision / game over sound
126:         break;
127:       }
128:     }
129: 
130:     // Score – increment each second survived
131:     if (!gameOver) {
132:       const now = Date.now();
133:       if (now - lastScoreTime >= 1000) {
134:         score++;
135:         playBeep(440, 0.08); // score increment sound
136:         lastScoreTime = now;
137:       }
138:     }
139:   }
140: 
141:   function draw() {
142:     // Background gradient
143:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
144:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#e0f7ff');
145:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#c2e0ff');
146:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
147:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
148: 
149:     // Draw player with rounded shape and shadow
150:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0a84ff';
151:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
152:     ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
153:     drawRoundedRect(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT, 6);
154:     ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
155: 
156:     // Draw blocks with rounded corners and individual colors
157:     for (const b of blocks) {
158:       ctx.fillStyle = b.color || 'red';
159:       drawRoundedRect(b.x, b.y, b.size, b.size, 4);
160:     }
161: 
162:     // Draw score with stylized font
163:     ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
164:     ctx.font = 'bold 20px sans-serif';
165:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
166:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);
167: 
168:     // Game over overlay
169:     if (gameOver) {
170:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
171:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
172:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
173:       ctx.font = 'bold 40px sans-serif';
174:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
175:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
176:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
177:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
178:     }
179:   }
180: 
181:     // Draw score
182:     ctx.fillStyle = 'blue';
183:     ctx.font = '20px Arial';
184:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);
185: 
186:     // Game over overlay
187:     if (gameOver) {
188:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
189:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
190:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
191:       ctx.font = '40px Arial';
192:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
193:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
194:       ctx.font = '30px Arial';
195:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
196:     }
197:   }
198: 
199:   function loop(timestamp) {
200:     if (!lastSpawn) lastSpawn = timestamp;
201:     const delta = timestamp - lastSpawn;
202:     if (delta >= BLOCK_SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
203:       spawnBlock();
204:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
205:     }
206:     if (!gameOver) update(delta);
207:     draw();
208:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
209:   }
210: 
211:   // Start the game
212:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
213: })();
